abilities.name: pickup
abilities.effect: Picks up other Pokémon's used and Flung held items.  May also pick up an item after battle.

abilities.name: technician
abilities.effect: Strengthens moves of 60 base power or less to 1.5× their power.

abilities.name: unnerve
abilities.effect: Prevents opposing Pokémon from eating held Berries.

kanto.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

original-johto.flavorText: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines too.

hoenn.flavorText: MEOWTH withdraw their sharp claws into their paws to silently sneak about. For some reason, this POKéMON loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

original-sinnoh.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

extended-sinnoh.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

updated-johto.flavorText: It loves anything that shines. It especially adores coins that it picks up and secretly hoards.

original-unova.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

updated-unova.flavorText: It is nocturnal in nature. If it spots something shiny, its eyes glitter brightly.

kalos.flavorText: Adores round objects. It wanders the streets on a nightly basis to look for dropped loose change.

updated-hoenn.flavorText: Meowth withdraws its sharp claws into its paws to slinkily sneak about without making any incriminating footsteps. For some reason, this Pokémon loves shiny coins that glitter with light.

original-alola.flavorText: It loves shiny things. It often fights with Murkrow over prey they’re both trying to catch.

updated-alola.flavorText: It loves coins, so if you give it one, you can make friends with Meowth easily. But it’s fickle, so you can’t count on that friendship lasting.

letsgo-kanto.flavorText: Appears to be more active at night. It loves round and shiny things. It can’t stop itself from picking them up.

swsh.flavorText: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.
